hypothesis: Source and scorer checks, plus known-key recovery that is exact or a ciphertext-equivalent rotation on every control, permit a calibrated full-text transposition search of QTXMA.
refuted_by: Source or scorer checks fail, a known-key control is recovered neither exactly nor as a ciphertext-equivalent rotation, or the target maximum fails matched complete-search calibration.
limitations: The published count corpus may overlap with some solved messages used for validation; message-level training membership is not documented.
The source form confirms group boundaries but does not establish word boundaries or a cipher procedure.
This remains a bounded search over ordinary double columnar transposition with ragged final rows.
The historical Phase 6 baseline is preserved for comparison, not reused as validation.

Rotation-aware accuracy credits a recovery only when it is a rotation of the known plaintext that some searched key enciphers to the identical control ciphertext; the exact-offset agreement, exact key recovery, and both plaintext scores are recorded separately.
The known-key controls are constructed or independently solved plaintexts, not authentic held-out Army traffic; they test the search and scorer, not corpus representativeness.
revision_rationale: The v2 run failed the independent solved-message 5x7 control because its acceptance rule credited a rotated recovery only when a stage width divides the message length. The 76-letter control has a one-letter ragged final row at width 5, which lets the first-stage order [4,1,0,2,3] encipher the plaintext rotated by one character to exactly the same ciphertext as the known order [3,0,4,1,2]; the search selected that equivalent key. The earlier reading of this as a row-filling convention mismatch is withdrawn: construction and untransposition agree. v3 credits a rotation only when some key in the searched widths enciphers it to the identical control ciphertext, computed exactly per control. The rule is stricter where divisibility over-admitted: the 148-letter primary control now admits offset zero only instead of 37 offsets.

additional_positive_controls.rationale: Length 133 is a multiple of neither stage width and, checked exactly, no alternative key enciphers any rotation of the plaintext to the same ciphertext, so only exact recovery can pass it.
